title: Is the AI Crash Starting?
speaker: A1 Trading panel: host with Allan and Merrily

macro_themes.view: Yields at these levels make investors cautious; rate-sensitive sectors (real estate, regional banks, industrials) have been hurt.
Korean memory sell-off on Chinese chip progress shows a fragile AI/Nasdaq setup.
A tech pullback could cool yields and help the Russell and Dow; breadth is improving from washed-out levels.
Big-tech expectations are so high that anything short of perfect, especially on capex and free cash flow, causes drama.
The curve flips between bear flattener and bear steepener; both mean yields rising, and markets need falling yields.

calls.reason: Fragile time for tech into earnings with high expectations and high yields; would not mind a pullback.
calls.quote: I've been kind of leaning off NASDAQ for a little while now

calls.reason: Bought after the large wick; breadth improving from washed-out levels, credit calm, yields pulling back favor a rotation into small caps.
calls.quote: I entered actually some um some Russell shares... So, that's where my stop is is below those lows

calls.reason: Money leaving AI may seek safety at attractive yields, a catalyst for a short-term bottom in TLT; sold 75.50 puts and took profits early.
calls.quote: that could be a really good catalyst to kind of put a bottom in in yields for the short term. TLT

calls.reason: Sold 820 calls (Nov 20 expiry) after Oct 28 earnings because expectations for big tech are extremely high.
